nights.title: Dallas Symphony Orchestra
nights.name: Dallas Symphony Orchestra
nights.extract: The Dallas Symphony Orchestra (DSO) is an American orchestra based in Dallas, Texas. Its principal performing venue is the Morton H. Meyerson Symphony Center in the Arts District of downtown Dallas.

en.who: The Dallas Symphony Orchestra, or DSO, is an American orchestra based in Dallas, Texas. Its main venue is the Morton H. Meyerson Symphony Center in the Arts District of downtown Dallas.
facts: The orchestra is based in Dallas, Texas.
Its principal performing venue is the Morton H. Meyerson Symphony Center.

de.who: Das Dallas Symphony Orchestra (DSO) ist ein amerikanisches Orchester mit Sitz in Dallas, Texas. Sein Hauptspielort ist das Morton H. Meyerson Symphony Center im Arts District der Innenstadt von Dallas.
facts: Das Orchester hat seinen Sitz in Dallas, Texas.
Der wichtigste Auftrittsort ist das Morton H. Meyerson Symphony Center.

tr.who: Dallas Symphony Orchestra (DSO), Dallas, Texas merkezli bir Amerikan orkestrasıdır. Başlıca konser mekânı, Dallas'ın şehir merkezindeki Arts District bölgesindeki Morton H. Meyerson Symphony Center'dır.
facts: Başlıca konser mekânı Morton H. Meyerson Symphony Center'dır.

nights.title: SouthFM
nights.name: SouthFM
nights.extract: SouthFM  is an American alternative rock band based in Dallas, Texas. They formed in 2000 and disbanded in October 2006. The band officially released two full-length albums, Drama Kids (2003) and Swallowing the Pill (2005). The band reunited for one concert in June 2010, and played more shows in November 2010. As of 2016, they have reformed and are working on a new album.

en.who: SouthFM is an American alternative rock band based in Dallas, Texas. They formed in 2000 and disbanded in October 2006; as of 2016 they had reformed.
facts: The band released two full-length albums, Drama Kids (2003) and Swallowing the Pill (2005).
The band reunited for one concert in June 2010.

de.who: SouthFM ist eine amerikanische Alternative-Rockband aus Dallas, Texas. Sie gründete sich 2000, löste sich im Oktober 2006 auf und hatte sich bis 2016 neu formiert.
facts: Die Band veröffentlichte die beiden Alben Drama Kids (2003) und Swallowing the Pill (2005).
Im Juni 2010 trat die Band für ein einziges Konzert wieder auf.

tr.who: SouthFM, Dallas, Texas merkezli bir Amerikan alternatif rock grubudur. 2000'de kuruldu, Ekim 2006'da dağıldı; 2016 itibarıyla yeniden toplanmıştı.
facts: Grup Drama Kids (2003) ve Swallowing the Pill (2005) adlı iki albüm yayımladı.
Haziran 2010'da tek bir konser için yeniden bir araya geldi.

nights.title: JOURNEY - Final Frontier Tour (An Evening With)
nights.name: Journey
nights.extract: Journey is an American rock band formed in San Francisco in 1973 by former members of Santana, the Steve Miller Band, and Frumious Bandersnatch. The band as of 2026 consists of Neal Schon on guitars and vocals; Jonathan Cain on keyboards, guitars and vocals; Deen Castronovo on drums and vocals; Arnel Pineda on lead vocals; Jason Derlatka on keyboards and vocals; and Todd Jensen on bass and vocals.

en.who: Journey is an American rock band formed in San Francisco in 1973 by former members of Santana, the Steve Miller Band and Frumious Bandersnatch. As of 2026 the line-up includes Neal Schon, Jonathan Cain, Deen Castronovo and Arnel Pineda.
facts: The band was formed in San Francisco in 1973.
Arnel Pineda sings on lead vocals as of 2026.

de.who: Journey ist eine amerikanische Rockband, die 1973 in San Francisco von ehemaligen Mitgliedern von Santana, der Steve Miller Band und Frumious Bandersnatch gegründet wurde. Zur Besetzung gehören 2026 unter anderem Neal Schon, Jonathan Cain, Deen Castronovo und Arnel Pineda.
facts: Die Band wurde 1973 in San Francisco gegründet.

tr.who: Journey, 1973'te San Francisco'da Santana, Steve Miller Band ve Frumious Bandersnatch'in eski üyeleri tarafından kurulmuş bir Amerikan rock grubudur. 2026 itibarıyla kadroda Neal Schon, Jonathan Cain, Deen Castronovo ve Arnel Pineda yer alıyor.
facts: 2026 itibarıyla Arnel Pineda baş vokalde yer alıyor.
